shape.text: The service account access token has a documented form (prefix, encoding or length).

unresolved.reason: None of the pages read describes the token's form, only its issuance, lifetime and carrier, so a bare value cannot be attributed to Atlas from its shape.

issuance.text: Atlas issues a Bearer access token in exchange for a service account's client ID and secret at its OAuth token endpoint and the token is sent in the Authorization header with the Bearer scheme.

lifecycle.text: The access token is reusable and valid for 1 hour (3600 seconds).

notes: Project-authored by the maintainers of this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Drafted from pages read 2026-10-04; nothing here asserts any product behaviour.
